_comment: Pools to hide even when they look active in the data — deprecated-but-functional venues a build can't detect. Each entry: the pool ("id" = DefiLlama pool id under poolIds; "key" = "project|chain|SYMBOL", case-insensitive, SYMBOL = DefiLlama's raw symbol, under keys; "address" = Morpho vault address from its app.morpho.org URL, under morphoVaults), an optional "name" for humans, a one-line "reason", the date "added" and "reviewBy" = added (or last review) + 30 days, all YYYY-MM-DD. Past reviewBy the build warns but keeps the pool hidden: renew the date or remove the entry. Anything listed here is dropped from the rankings.
